notes.title: 1.0 Version is Uploaded & Release is Tomorrow!
notes.content:
What has been done: 

- Some players had issues when starting the game, they were "flying arround". Now all players will start, functional backup system is in place 

- Camera fixes 

- Voice/text adjustments 

- Animation fixes 

- Pathfinding 

- Ability System got a backup system, to make sure the game doesn´t break 

- Balancing, many units got small changes 

  

What is still there:  

  

- In the Toxic Temple frame drops still happen, it is less than before. However, to be honest, I don´t know how to fully fix it. It is not breaking the game; it just becomes slower on one map. 

- Sarah still puts her hand into the ground... nothing breaking the game. Sorry, it's still on my list. 

Looking foreword to hear your Feedback. 

  

Tomorrow is Release!

notes.title: Let´s Play A Game´s Tale
notes.content:
Let´s Play, Chat and have a good time while playing A Game´s Tale. A game where you play Herold, who travels through a fantasy world, wins tactical battles with his growing deck full of divers units. All that happens while he meets exiting characters to find out why we play. 

Welcome, thanks for showing up, let´s have a good time :)

notes.title: Let´s Play A Game´s Tale
notes.content:
Thank you for watching, I hope you enjoy A Game´s Tale, a game where you play tactical battles in uniqe maps while you are traveling though a fantasy world solving the mystery of why we play.


 Let me a follow and a wishlist, thank you, but more importandly let us have a good time :)
